content: Onasemalimali ai masulina manuna
ꞌEbweu wate onasemalimali Yesu ꞌiꞌebwaꞌedi, ꞌigwae,
“Yaubada ꞌina loina ꞌatuwa kini ꞌebweuna ꞌemasula ꞌiguinuwena natuna meꞌolotona ꞌina ai manuna.
ꞌEnega ꞌina toguinuwao ꞌietunedi be yaisigedi taudi ꞌiemataluwediya sida bwauyedima ꞌemasula ꞌenaya, ga sitauya sabi bwauyedima ta tomotai nidi kini ꞌina bwau siguitoyasena.

“ꞌEnega ꞌaina wate ꞌina toguinuwao ꞌietunedi be taudi ꞌiemataluwediya sida eonadi wate ꞌaene ‘ꞌInapwana ꞌina ꞌemasula niꞌatu ꞌigibubuna. ꞌIna bulumakau sinabwadi ta ꞌina bulumakau mwaneyaudi niꞌatu ꞌiunudi be masula maiboꞌana ꞌigibubuna. Wada ma be tatatauya natunana ꞌina ai masulina wada ꞌani.’
Ta taudi nigeya simeema, ꞌenega ꞌaidi sipili kwaiya ga mali sena be mali sena ꞌediya sitauya. ꞌEbweu tai ꞌina bagulaya ꞌitauya, ꞌebweu tai ꞌina paisewa ꞌena ꞌitauya,
ta ꞌaidi wate ꞌinapwana ꞌina toguinuwao sigiyaidi ga sigie omayamayaedi ta siloemwawasidi.
“ꞌEnega kini nina ꞌigamwasowala ꞌaiꞌaila ga ꞌina tolosaiyao ꞌietunedi ga toloemwawasa nidi simutudi ta ꞌidi ꞌasa sigabuna.
“Ta kini nina ꞌina toguinuwao ꞌediya ꞌigwae, ‘Ai masulina niꞌatu gibugibubuna ta esi taudi yaemataluwediya nigeya sawesawenaya be simama.
ꞌEnega ꞌeda ꞌediya wasakowasi be yaisigedi walobadi waꞌauꞌewedima be ai masulina siꞌaꞌani.’
ꞌEnega siapwesa ꞌedaya ga tomota yauyaudi siegogonedima, ꞌaidi totoꞌumalidi be ꞌaidi toboboꞌadi ga ꞌenega ai ꞌana anuwa nina siloemaena.
“Tuta nina kini ꞌimai ꞌowagao sabi ꞌitadi ga tai ꞌebweuna ꞌiꞌita lobena, tauna nigeya ai ꞌoamana ꞌiꞌoteꞌote,
ꞌenega ꞌienaidena, ꞌigwae, ‘Gosiyagu, mwaꞌadega ai ꞌoamana nigeya ꞌuꞌoteꞌote, ta toꞌesega ꞌuluguma?’ Ta tai nina nigeya sawesawenaya be enaida gete ꞌieꞌisa.
ꞌEnega kini nina ꞌina toguinuwao ꞌieonedi, ‘Tai gote wagiyai be nimana be ꞌaena wayonidi be waula apwese sena guguyoi ꞌenaya, be gote ꞌena tomota sidedoi ta siesalaꞌiꞌita ꞌelouya ꞌenega.
“Manuna tomota yaudi Yaubada ꞌina emataluwa silobena, ta puꞌepuꞌedimo ꞌiesinuwedi.”
Takisi Kini Sisa manuna
Ta Palisiyao taudimo sideli egogonama ga siloina mwaꞌadega be enaidega sikaboe be Yesu ꞌina loegesi siloba.

ꞌEnega loina silobena, ta ꞌadi tomuliyayao be Elodi ꞌina bodao maꞌediyao sietunedi Yesu ꞌena ga sigwae, “ꞌInapwana niꞌatu ꞌamwalatonimu ꞌaene ꞌoyo toeꞌita ꞌaiꞌaila be Yaubada ꞌina nuwanuwa ꞌueꞌita ꞌaiꞌaila, ta wate tomota ꞌidi waiwai manuna nigeya ꞌumatamatauta, ta tuga ona ꞌaiꞌaila ꞌusimana leleleya tomota maiboꞌadi ꞌediya.
ꞌEnega gete tuga ꞌuda eonama, mwaꞌadega sawesawenaya be Kini Sisa manuna takisi tasaꞌu, nai nigeya?”
Ta Yesu ꞌidi nuwanuwa toꞌumalina ꞌimwalatonina, ꞌenega ꞌiona, igwae, “ꞌOmi tokabo! Toꞌase manuna watootoogu?
Ta baga mani nina takisi manuna waeꞌitagu.” ꞌEnega mani ꞌebweuna siꞌebwaꞌena.
Ga Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Wada eonagu, mani gete ꞌena yaita ꞌana maꞌamaꞌayau ta ꞌana esana?”
Ta sigwae, “Kini Sisa.” ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌieonedi, “O, nadigega. ꞌEnega ꞌeguma Kini ꞌina yage waꞌebwaya Kini ꞌenaya, ta ꞌeguma Yaubada ꞌina yage Yaubada waꞌebwaꞌe.”
Yesu ꞌina ona sinasinapu wawasae sinonona ga nigeya ꞌidi ꞌebe onamo, ꞌenega sipilisinena ga sitauya.
Tomwawasa ꞌidi toololimana
Gote ꞌasiyata nina ꞌenaya ꞌaina Sadusiyao, taudi nigeya siemiemisa tomwawasa ꞌidi toololimana manuna, simai ga Yesu ꞌena sienaida,

sigwae, “ꞌInapwana, Mosese ꞌina loina ꞌigwae, ‘ꞌEguma tai mamwanena ta nigeya natudimo be tai nina ꞌimwamwawasa, tai nina tasina kwabulinana maꞌiyana sida ai, be ꞌenega ꞌabo waine ꞌienatuna, natunao tokwaiya nina ꞌana lopaꞌeluyao.’
ꞌEbweu tai matasinao sikisi maꞌemao ꞌamiyami, ta tai nina ꞌiai ga ꞌimwawasa, ta nigeya natunamo, ta tokwaiya nina tasina selabenega kwabulina maꞌiyana siai,
ta tasinana wate ꞌimwawasa, ta tauna wate nigeya natunamo. Ta nadigega tuga tasinao maiboꞌadi kwabula nina siaiai,
ta mulidiyega waine wate ꞌimwawasa.
ꞌEnega toololimana ꞌana tutaya waine nina to tai batu mwaneꞌaiꞌailina? Manuna maiboꞌadi niꞌatu siaina.”
Ta Yesu enaida gete ꞌieꞌisena, ꞌigwae, “Gete ꞌimi loegesi, manuna Buki Tabu nigeya wamwalamwalatoni, ta wate Yaubada ꞌina waiwai nigeya wamwalamwalatoni.
Toololimana ꞌana tutaya tomota geyaꞌabo siaiai ta esi ꞌidi miya aniloseyao galewaya nadigega.
Ta Yaubada ꞌina ona ꞌemiya toololimana manuna Buki Tabu ꞌena ꞌigwae,

‘ꞌAboꞌagu Ebelaamo ꞌina Yaubada ta Aisake ꞌina Yaubada ta Yekobe ꞌina Yaubada.’ Yaubada nigeya tomota mwawamwawasidi ꞌidi Yaubada, ta esi tomota mayawasidi ꞌidi Yaubada, ꞌenega ꞌinapwanao nidi mayawasidi gete tuga simiyami.”
Yesu ꞌina ona gete tomota yaudi sinonona ma idi gwausowala ꞌina eꞌita waiwaina manuna.
Loina sinabwana
ꞌEnega Palisiyao niꞌatu sinonona ꞌaene Yesu Sadusiyao ꞌidi enaida ꞌieꞌisena ta nigeya ꞌebweu wate ꞌidi ꞌebe onamo, ꞌenega Palisiyao nidi Yesu ꞌenaya simai,
ga ꞌediyega ꞌebweu loina ꞌana tosinasinapu Yesu ꞌena ꞌienaida sabi toona, ꞌigwae,
“Toeꞌita, loina maiboꞌadi ꞌediyega to loina sinabwana?”
Ta Yesu ꞌigwae, “ꞌImu ꞌInapwana Yaubada ꞌuda obobome ꞌateyo be yaluyaluwayo be ꞌimu nuwanuwa maiboꞌadi ꞌediyega.’
Gete gimiloina ta sinabwana.
Ta ꞌebweu wate loina sinabwana gete nadigega ꞌigwae, ‘Gosemwao ꞌuda obobomedi, nadigega tauyo ꞌamu oboboma.’
“Loina ꞌeluwa getedi, loina maiboꞌadi be palopitao ꞌidi ona maiboꞌadi ꞌadi ꞌautui.”
Toꞌetoseyana nina tauna Debida ꞌina susu
Tuta nina Palisiyao sideli egogonama ga Yesu ꞌieonedi, ꞌigwae, “Mwaꞌadega Toꞌetoseyana nina Keliso, yaita ꞌina susuyega ꞌiapwesa?”
Ta sigwae, “Debida.”
ꞌEnega Yesu ꞌigwae, “Mwaꞌadega ga ꞌenega lowa Yaluyaluwa Tabuna Debida ꞌigiesinapuna ga Debida Toꞌetoseyana nina ꞌiꞌawa ꞌinapwanaena, ꞌigwae,
‘Yaubada ꞌiona ꞌigu ꞌInapwana ꞌenaya, ꞌigwae: ꞌAtaiguya ꞌumiyatowa be ꞌana laba ꞌamu talauwalao yasaꞌu mwaꞌutedi ꞌaeyo ꞌubuninaya.’
ꞌEguma Debida ꞌina ꞌinapwana Toꞌetoseyana nina, mwaꞌadega sana ga Debida ꞌina susuyega muliyega Toꞌetoseyana ꞌiapwesama?”
Yesu ꞌina enaida gete nigeya ꞌebweu wate yaita sawesawenaya be ꞌieꞌisa, ga tuta muliyega Yesu simatautena ꞌenega, nigeya ꞌebweu yaita ꞌitootoo be ꞌienaida limana Yesu ꞌenaya.
